title: Mock article / Idempotent pipelines
summary: Synthetic long-form notes about retries and replay.

blocks.text: A pipeline is easier to operate when rerunning the same logical batch does not create duplicate business effects. Idempotency is therefore a design property of the write boundary, not merely a retry setting.

items: Assign a stable batch or source-range identity.
Write to a staging or deterministic partition.
Commit or swap the intended target atomically where possible.
Record the successful run and source watermark.

blocks.title: Illustrative deterministic load boundary
blocks.explanation: This is only illustrative; transaction semantics depend on the actual platform.

blocks.title: Trap
blocks.text: Retrying a non-idempotent append can duplicate rows even when orchestration reports only one final successful run.
